lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
app-CJv3EAiU: 763 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 763 B.
1 delivered file carries no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
879 B in 33 pieces of 21 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (120 packages, 1,501 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in dist is left without something that loads it.
